title: What Scripture Actually Means by "Be Angry and Do Not Sin"
caption:
A godly man's anger isn't the sin everyone told you it was.

Ephesians 4:26 splits anger from sin on purpose. Paul doesn't command the feeling away, he commands what you do with it. Anger that stays unnamed doesn't disappear. It goes underground and comes out sideways, at your girlfriend, your roommate, whoever's closest.

"Do not let the sun go down on your anger" isn't poetry. It's a deadline. And the same anger that could wreck your night can tell you what you actually care about, if you aim it right.

A godly man doesn't kill his anger. He puts it under orders.

theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
